summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Alexa Grey adult companion landing page. All 7 pytest backend tests passed (health, booking create, persistence, and 4 validation cases). Full end-to-end UI flow verified: age gate blocks page + locks body scroll, enter dismisses gate, hero + all page sections render with images loading, gallery starts blurred with overlay, reveal removes blur, lightbox opens on click, booking form validates empty submissions, and a real submission was persisted in MongoDB and confirmed via GET /api/bookings. email_sent=false is EXPECTED (Resend not configured) and NOT reported as a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_booking response uses Booking.from_mongo(doc).model_dump(by_alias=False) which correctly hides _id — good.
server.py: BookingCreate uses EmailStr and Field(min_length=1) so validation returns 422 as expected.
server.py: send_booking_email() gracefully returns False when RESEND_API_KEY/OWNER_EMAIL are empty — clean.

BookingForm.js: client-side validation only checks name/email/phone/location but backend also requires duration; since duration has a default from DURATION_OPTIONS[1] this is fine, but if select is emptied programmatically the 422 would surface only as generic 'Something went wrong' — consider showing server-side validation errors to user.
Gallery.js: videos use autoPlay={revealed}; on some browsers autoplay may be blocked without user gesture but click-to-reveal counts as a gesture so it works — OK.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).
backend does not currently rate-limit POST /api/bookings — consider basic throttling or captcha before public launch (adult site is a spam magnet).
seed_data_creation: Created test bookings with TEST_ prefix via pytest + one UI booking (TEST_ui_*). Left in DB (bookings collection). Total 4 records after this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Run pytest with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Email sending is intentionally disabled (RESEND_API_KEY and OWNER_EMAIL empty in backend/.env) — email_sent=false is EXPECTED, not a bug. All 5 media assets (2 images + 3 videos) load from customer-assets-39nsmqrw.emergentagent.net. Gallery testids: media-gallery, gallery-reveal-btn, gallery-overlay-reveal, gallery-item-0..4, gallery-lightbox. Booking form testids: booking-name/phone/email/date/duration/location/message, booking-extra-cob/bbbj/pse/anal, booking-submit-btn, booking-error, booking-success, booking-reset-btn. Age gate testid: age-verification-gate, age-gate-enter-btn.
